name: Smart Bulk Content Remover
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Smart Bulk Content Remover gives you a powerful yet simple interface to clean up and maintain your WordPress site by removing unwanted content in bulk.

Whether you need to delete outdated posts, old pages, unused media files or spam comments, this plugin provides a safe and streamlined interface – no more manually deleting one by one.

What you can do

  • Bulk delete Posts, Pages, Custom Post Types (Products, News, Books, etc.).
  • Bulk delete Media files with statistics (total images, attached/unattached images and size).
  • Bulk delete Comments across posts with status filters.

Advanced Filters

Each section includes flexible filters so you can target only the content you want to remove:

  • Filter by Post Type, Status (published, draft, pending, spam, trash), Author and Date Range.
  • Search by Title or Content.
  • Filter Media by Date Range, Month, Year, or Author before deletion.
  • Select individual items or use “Select All”.

Safe Deletion Options

  • Choose between moving items to the Trash or permanent deletion (skip Trash).
  • Non-destructive by default — you can restore items from Trash if needed.

Clean, Responsive UI

  • Separate admin pages for Pages, Posts, Media, and Comments (see screenshots).
  • WordPress-native styling for an intuitive experience.
  • Works automatically with WordPress core post types and any public custom post types.

This plugin is ideal for site owners, bloggers, editors, and administrators who need to quickly clean up large amounts of content.

Features

  • Bulk delete posts, pages, custom post types, media files, and comments.
  • Flexible filters: search by title/content, status, author, date range.
  • Media statistics: see total number and size of attached/unattached images before deleting.
  • Safe deletion: option to move content to Trash or delete permanently.
  • Lightweight & fast: minimal overhead with a focus on performance.
  • Responsive admin UI integrated into the WordPress dashboard.

Credits

Developed by Kirtikumar Solanki.
Donations are welcome at PayPal.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-bulk-content-remover directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools → Smart Bulk Content Remover (or the plugin’s menu) to access the interface.
  4. Choose the section (Pages, Posts, Media, Comments).
  5. Use the filters to select which content you want to remove and click the delete button.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin permanently delete content?

By default, items are moved to the Trash. You can check the “Permanently delete” option to skip the Trash and remove content immediately.

Will it work with custom post types?

Yes. It automatically detects and lists all public custom post types registered on your site.

Can I filter media files by month or author?

Yes. The Media remover has additional filters for Date Range, Month, Year and Author.

Is there an undo option?

If you move content to the Trash, you can restore it from the WordPress Trash screen. Permanent deletion cannot be undone.
